settings.clips.title: Clips
settings.clips.description: Keep the last few minutes of play in memory and save the good bits with one key.
settings.clips.enabled.description: Starts with the game and keeps recording quietly in the background.
settings.clips.applied: Ready. Press {{keys}} to save a clip.
settings.clips.status.idle: Waiting for the game to start.
settings.clips.status.recording: Recording. The last few minutes are being kept.
settings.clips.status.paused: Paused. Nothing is being kept right now.
settings.clips.status.fullscreen: Minecraft is in exclusive fullscreen, where Windows allows no recording. Switch to windowed or borderless.
settings.clips.status.failed: Recording stopped because of an error. See the log for details.
settings.clips.hotkeys.title: Keys
settings.clips.hotkeys.description: Pick any key you like — these are yours to choose.
settings.clips.hotkeys.warning: These keys go to the launcher, not to Minecraft. Pick something the game does not need, or that action will stop working while clips are on.
settings.clips.hotkeys.save.description: Saves what just happened, from the buffer.
settings.clips.hotkeys.toggle.descriptio: Stops and resumes keeping history, without closing anything.
settings.clips.buffer.title: Clip length
settings.clips.buffer.description: How much of what just happened a clip covers. It is kept in memory and thrown away as it ages — nothing is written to disk until you save one.
settings.clips.buffer.length.description: Saving takes these last seconds. Uses about {{mb}} MB of memory.
settings.clips.quality.title: Recording quality
settings.clips.quality.description: Higher settings look better, use more memory and take longer to upload.
settings.clips.quality.preset.low.descri: For weaker PCs and fast uploads
settings.clips.quality.bitrate.descripti: The main thing that decides both file size and how much memory the buffer needs.
settings.clips.quality.memory: About {{mb}} MB of memory for {{seconds}} seconds of {{resolution}} at {{fps}} fps.
settings.clips.quality.codec.description: How the video is compressed. Newer codecs make smaller files, but not everyone can play them.
settings.clips.quality.codec.h265.note: Around 25% smaller, needs a Windows add-on
settings.clips.quality.codec.av1.note: Up to 50% smaller, newer devices only
settings.clips.quality.codec.unavailable: Your graphics card cannot record this
settings.clips.quality.encoder.probing: Checking what this PC can record with…
settings.clips.quality.encoder.none: Nothing on this PC can record this codec.
settings.clips.quality.encoder.cpu_only: Only the processor can record this codec here, which takes performance away from the game.
settings.clips.quality.audio.description: Everything you hear: the game, voice chat, music.
settings.clips.storage.title: Where clips go
settings.clips.storage.description: Saved clips are MP4 files you can play, edit or upload anywhere.
settings.clips.storage.default: In the launcher folder, under clips
hotkey.conflict: Already used by the other action
settings.clips.quality.codec.fallback: {{requested}} is not possible on this PC — clips are being recorded as {{actual}} on the {{encoder}} instead.
settings.clips.audio.title: Sound
settings.clips.audio.description: What a clip records alongside the picture.
settings.clips.audio.source.description: Everything you hear, only the game, or both with their own volume.
settings.clips.audio.source.unsupported: Recording the game on its own needs a newer Windows version, so everything you hear is recorded instead.
settings.clips.audio.device.description: Which output the sound is taken from.
settings.clips.audio.device.missing: Saved device — not connected right now
settings.clips.audio.volume.description: How loud each side is in the clip. This changes the recording only — what you hear while playing stays as it is.
settings.clips.audio.microphone.descript: Adds your microphone to the clip, on top of whatever else is being recorded.
settings.clips.storage.limit_description: Oldest clips are deleted once the folder passes {{gb}} GB.
settings.clips.storage.limit_off: No limit — clips are never deleted automatically.
settings.clips.library.title: Your clips
settings.clips.library.description: Watch, delete or find them on disk.
